name: changedetection.io
description: Watches web pages for changes — prices, availability, a line of text, a JSON value — on a schedule, and sends a notification through any of the services it supports when one is found.

access.note: changedetection.io starts without a password: anyone who reaches the address can see and edit every watch and the notification settings. Set one under Settings → Password protection the moment the deployment is ready, or keep the domain behind the dashboard's own password protection. Fetching with a real browser (for pages built by JavaScript) needs the separate Playwright container this template does not include; plain fetches work as deployed.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Notifications link back to the watch at this address.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The watch list, its settings and the API

volumes.name: datastore
volumes.purpose: Every watch, its history of snapshots and the settings

update.notes: The datastore is upgraded in place on start and is not readable by an older version afterwards.
